verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-infrastructure platform, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. A probe confirms a first-party MCP server documented under the docs' integrations section, but the pack has no detail on what it does or how to connect to it. missing for 10: details of the MCP server's tools and capabilities, setup and connection instructions for agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
